newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS-Kingfisher puts bought as punt.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS-Kingfisher puts bought as punt.

text.p: Shares in Kingfisher jumped after the UK retailing group reported a 47 percent rise in its first-half pre-tax profits, but options traders were betting the shares will soon retreat, dealers said.
More than 1,000 October 650 puts in Kingfisher were purchased between 8p and 10p, they said.
"The shares have had a good run, but I'm surprised anyone would be so aggressive," said one dealer of the purchase.
By 1353 GMT, the shares were up 10p to 675p, after rising as high as 680p earlier.
The shares have risen more than 25 percent since April.
Trading was relatively light in most other stock option markets, dealers said.
They noted purchases of 500 September 100 calls in Sears at 1/2p, 650 October 330 puts in Safeway at 6p, and 950 November 280 puts in Tesco at 3-1/2p.
Elsewhere, volume in FTSE options remained thin. Dealers said there was good two-way business in September 3925 calls.
"I wouldn't say it reflects bullish sentiment. I think that people are just rolling over from lower strikes," said one.
